roadmap.title: Track scheduled Battle Hub Tournaments
roadmap.description: Check the Battle Hub event schedule immediately and enter tournaments whenever they are available. Five appearances and 10 individual match wins are the only time-gated requirements.

roadmap.title: Complete World Tour
roadmap.description: Finish the World Tour tutorial and story while completing 22 sub-missions, raising one master Bond to 100, using a Master Action, changing clothes, and completing one part-time job.

roadmap.title: Clear Fighting Ground and solo Extreme Battles
roadmap.description: Finish the Tutorials, Training, one Character Guide, one Arcade run, and 45 Combo Trials. Use level-1 CPU Extreme Battles to finish all 20 matches and wins without online matchmaking.

roadmap.title: Collect Battle Hub interactions
roadmap.description: Enter Battle Hub and clear the Game Center, spectator, club, chat, replay, friend, DJ Booth, big-screen, and first-Nice achievements before beginning the long match counters.

roadmap.title: Finish online match and social counters
roadmap.description: Use regular cabinets, Avatar Battles, and Fighting Ground online play to finish their match and win totals. Send Nices after matches, while spectating, and through idle-avatar interactions until the combined counter reaches 600.

achievements.description: Where's your face, dingus? Get your butt to the avatar creator and sort yourself out! Crying shame we can't fix that attitude of yours while we're at it.
achievements.summary: Finish creating and saving an avatar in either @loc{World Tour} or @loc{Battle Hub}.

guide.context: World Tour is the efficient starting route because avatar creation occurs before its tutorial and story achievements.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{World Tour} or @mechanic{Battle Hub} from the main menu.
Complete every required avatar-creation screen and save the finished avatar.

achievements.displayName: So This Is the Battle Hub...
achievements.description: Ah, yes. Welcome to the Battle Hub. I do not know what you seek, but please, enjoy yourself. That is the purpose for which it was built, after all.
achievements.summary: Select @mechanic{Battle Hub} from the main menu and enter any available hub server.

guide.context: Battle Hub uses live online services; the game displays any account or connection setup it requires before server selection.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Battle Hub} from the main menu and continue to the server-selection screen.
Choose any available hub server and wait until your avatar enters Battle Hub.

achievements.description: Start by fighting a match in the Battle Hub. It doesn't matter if you win or lose. What matters is challenging yourself to take that first step.
achievements.summary: Finish one regular match against another player at a @mechanic{Battle Hub cabinet}.

guide.context: A regular cabinet match begins when players occupy both sides of a paired machine. Winning is not required.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Battle Hub} and sit at one side of an available regular battle cabinet.
Wait for another player to sit at the paired cabinet, then finish the complete match.

achievements.description: How's 30 matches in the Battle Hub sound? If yer not there yet, just keep at it! If ya wanna get sumo strong, ya can't be shy of the ring!
achievements.summary: Finish @mechanic{30 regular Battle Hub cabinet matches} against other players.

guide.context: Losses count, and the same matches also advance the 30-win and 100-total-Battle-Hub counters.

steps.text: Sit at a regular Battle Hub cabinet and wait for another player to occupy the paired side.
Finish matches against online opponents until the regular cabinet total reaches @mechanic{30}.

achievements.description: Starting to get used to competition? Then set your sights on winning 30 Battle Hub matches. Gotta give yourself a challenge if you want to get anywhere in life.
achievements.summary: Win @mechanic{30 regular Battle Hub cabinet matches} against other players.

guide.context: Every qualifying win also contributes to the 30-match and 100-total-Battle-Hub achievements, so remain at a cabinet for rematches when an opponent agrees.

steps.text: Sit at a regular Battle Hub cabinet and begin matches against online opponents.
Keep playing and taking rematches until the cumulative regular-cabinet win count reaches @mechanic{30}.

achievements.description: Ever hear of Extreme Battles? They're a little different from regular fights—a little more WILD. Try it out, and let your instincts take over!
achievements.summary: Finish one @mechanic{Extreme Battle} at a Battle Hub cabinet or through @mechanic{Fighting Ground > Special Match}.

guide.context: Fighting Ground Extreme Battles against the CPU count, so this achievement does not require an online opponent.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Fighting Ground > Special Match > Extreme Battle}.
Choose any rule and gimmick, set the CPU to a comfortable level, and finish the match.

achievements.description: If you can't adapt, you won't last five seconds on the battlefield. Fight 20 Extreme Battles. Perfect training to sharpen your judgement.
achievements.summary: Finish @mechanic{20 Extreme Battles}; use @mechanic{Down & Out} against a level-1 CPU in Fighting Ground for reliable solo progress.

guide.context: The same CPU matches also build the 20-win counter, allowing both long Extreme Battle achievements to be completed together.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Fighting Ground > Special Match > Extreme Battle}.
Select @mechanic{Down & Out}, choose any gimmick or none, and set the CPU to @mechanic{level 1}.
Finish matches until the cumulative Extreme Battle total reaches @mechanic{20}.

achievements.description: 20 wins in Extreme Battle. Should be a snap for someone like you, yeah? Stomp this one flat, then aim for even greater heights! Bwahaha!
achievements.summary: Win @mechanic{20 Extreme Battles}; use @mechanic{Down & Out} against a level-1 CPU in Fighting Ground.

guide.context: CPU victories in Fighting Ground count exactly like Battle Hub Extreme wins, removing the need to wait at an online cabinet.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Fighting Ground > Special Match > Extreme Battle}.
Choose @mechanic{Down & Out}, set the CPU to @mechanic{level 1}, and select any gimmick or none.
Use throws or heavy knockdown attacks to win matches until the counter reaches @mechanic{20 victories}.

achievements.description: In Avatar Battles, you can battle others as an avatar―a self outside of your self. Go there, and experience all that such combat has to offer.
achievements.summary: Finish one @mechanic{Avatar Battle} against another player in the center of Battle Hub.

guide.context: Avatar Battles use custom avatars and are started from the hub's central arena rather than a cabinet.

steps.text: Enter the central Avatar Battle area in @loc{Battle Hub}.
Issue or accept an Avatar Battle challenge and finish the complete match.

achievements.description: Nothing gets my engine revving more than a brawl between avatars, live and in the flesh! Let's see you do 20 Avatar Battles!
achievements.summary: Finish @mechanic{20 Avatar Battles} against other players in the center of Battle Hub.

guide.context: Losses count toward the 20-match total, while every win simultaneously advances the separate 20-win achievement.

steps.text: Go to the central Avatar Battle area and issue or accept challenges from other players.
Finish Avatar Battles until the cumulative match total reaches @mechanic{20}.

achievements.description: An alternate form of combat, with an alternate path to victory. Get 20 wins in Avatar Battles. But don't obsess over the results. Let experience be your guide.
achievements.summary: Win @mechanic{20 Avatar Battles} against other players in the center of Battle Hub.

guide.context: Avatar strength depends on World Tour progression and equipment, so completing World Tour before this online grind provides a stronger character.

steps.text: Equip the strongest available avatar gear and enter the central Avatar Battle area in @loc{Battle Hub}.
Challenge other avatars and continue until the cumulative win total reaches @mechanic{20}.

achievements.description: If you wanna match the one-and-only Jamie Siu, you'd better be early to the starting line. Give a Tournament a shot!
achievements.summary: Register with @npc{Sebastian}, join the assigned server at the listed start time, and play at least one @mechanic{Tournament match}.

guide.context: Tournament registration alone does not count. Each event has a fixed start time and may take place on a different Battle Hub server from the one used to register.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Battle Hub}, speak with @npc{Sebastian}, and open the scheduled Tournament list.
Register for an available Tournament, then note its start time and assigned Battle Hub server.
Before the event begins, move to the assigned server and remain there until your bracket is called.
Play at least one Tournament match and confirm that @mechanic{Gazing at the Peak} unlocks.

achievements.description: The determination to stand in the ring and fight is what turns mind and muscle into tempered steel! Enter five Tournaments, and see for yourself!
achievements.summary: For each of @mechanic{5 Battle Hub Tournaments}, register with @npc{Sebastian}, join the assigned server on time, and play a bracket match.

guide.context: Tournament appearances accumulate only when you show up and play; signing up for five events without participating is insufficient. Events may be separated by weeks, so check the schedule throughout the rest of the guide.

steps.text: In @loc{Battle Hub}, speak with @npc{Sebastian} and register for an available Tournament.
Join the event's assigned server before its listed start time and play at least one bracket match.
Repeat the registration-and-participation process until @mechanic{5 Tournaments} have counted.

achievements.description: Ninja can leap staircases in a single bound, but there's no skipping steps in training. Win 10 matches in a Tournament. It won't be easy, but you can do it.
achievements.summary: Join scheduled @mechanic{Battle Hub Tournaments} on time and win @mechanic{10 individual best-of-three games}; wins in lost sets count.

guide.context: The counter tracks individual games within a best-of-three set, not entire Tournament victories. A 1–2 set loss still contributes one win, making regular participation more important than winning a full bracket.

steps.text: Register with @npc{Sebastian}, join the assigned Battle Hub server, and enter the Tournament at its scheduled time.
Win as many individual games as possible during each best-of-three Tournament set.
Continue entering scheduled Tournaments until the cumulative counter reaches @mechanic{10 game wins}.

achievements.description: Kung fu is the result of ceaseless training. Do anything enough times, and you'll see results. So will you, once you fight in the Battle Hub 100 times.
achievements.summary: Finish @mechanic{100 total Battle Hub fights} across regular cabinets, Extreme Battles, Avatar Battles, and Tournaments.

guide.context: All Battle Hub fight types contribute, so the regular-cabinet, Avatar, Extreme, and Tournament requirements should be completed before doing dedicated cleanup.

steps.text: Complete the other Battle Hub match and Tournament achievements first.
If the total remains below @mechanic{100 fights}, continue finishing matches at any Battle Hub cabinet or Avatar Battle area.

achievements.description: Did you know you can play classic games at the Battle Hub Game Center? It's true! Cassette tapes and cartridges might be old...but they're still hecka rad.
achievements.summary: At the @loc{Battle Hub Game Center}, sit at any active classic-game cabinet and open the game.

guide.context: The Game Center rotates its available classic Capcom titles, but any cabinet in the current lineup qualifies.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Battle Hub} and walk to the @loc{Game Center}.
Sit at an available classic-game cabinet and open the selected game.

achievements.description: Ever try the Ranking Challenge at the Game Center? Give it a shot! It's important to always challenge yourself, even when it comes to games.
achievements.summary: At the @loc{Battle Hub Game Center}, choose @mechanic{High Score Challenge} on any classic-game cabinet.

guide.context: A leaderboard placement is not required. Opening the classic game's High Score Challenge menu is sufficient.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Battle Hub Game Center} and sit at any available classic-game cabinet.
Select @mechanic{High Score Challenge} and continue into the classic game's menu.

achievements.description: Having an audience changes everything...and turns a mere fight into thrilling spectacle. Spectate a Battle Hub Match, and bear witness to glory.
achievements.summary: Approach a regular Battle Hub cabinet already in use and spectate the active match.

guide.context: Use a regular character cabinet rather than an Extreme cabinet or the central Avatar arena; those spectator types have separate achievements.

steps.text: Find a regular Battle Hub cabinet with an active match.
Approach the occupied cabinet, choose the spectate option, and allow the match view to load.

achievements.description: In combat, you must constantly analyze the situation. Spectate an Extreme Battle, and hone your ability to read and react to the unexpected.
achievements.summary: Approach an @mechanic{Extreme Battle cabinet} already in use and spectate the active match.

guide.context: Playing an Extreme Battle against the CPU satisfies the match counters, but this spectator achievement specifically needs an active Battle Hub cabinet.

steps.text: In @loc{Battle Hub}, find an Extreme Battle cabinet with two players fighting.
Approach the occupied Extreme cabinet, choose the spectate option, and allow the match view to load.

achievements.description: Ah, there's nothing quite like a fight, one-on-one, in the flesh! If you wanna appreciate it too, go spectate an Avatar Battle!
achievements.summary: Approach an @mechanic{Avatar Battle} in progress at the center of Battle Hub and spectate it.

guide.context: Avatar Battles use the custom World Tour-style avatars in the hub's central arena, not the nearby character cabinets.

steps.text: Go to the central Avatar Battle area in @loc{Battle Hub}.
Approach two avatars already fighting, select the spectate option, and allow the battle view to load.

achievements.description: Sounds like the Battle Hub has clubs you can join. Just like a sumo stable! You should join one! Ooh, I wonder if they have chanko stew...
achievements.summary: Open your own online player profile, select @mechanic{Clubs}, and join any Battle Hub club.

guide.context: Club membership is managed through the player's online profile rather than an NPC or cabinet on the Battle Hub floor.

steps.text: Open your player profile while connected to Street Fighter 6 online services.
Select @mechanic{Clubs}, choose an available club, and complete the join action.

achievements.displayName: Let the Praise Become Your Muscle
achievements.description: Hrrah! To fight before a cheering crowd is an honor shared by all wrestlers! Go on—try earning yourself a "Nice" fan of your own!
achievements.summary: Send or receive one @mechanic{Nice} through an online match, spectator screen, or another player's profile.

guide.context: Sent and received Nice marks feed the same achievement counter, so you do not need to wait for another player to praise you.

steps.text: Open another player's profile in Battle Hub, or reach an online match or spectator results screen.
Use the displayed @mechanic{Nice} action once and allow the counter to update.

achievements.description: Uwo! My dream's to become famous, and make Mama proud! You should become famous too! Try sending or receiving 200 "Nice!" marks, for starters!
achievements.summary: Reach a combined total of @mechanic{200 Nice marks sent or received} in Street Fighter 6 online modes.

guide.context: Sending and receiving Nices feed the same counter. Nices can be sent after online matches, while spectating, or by inspecting an idle avatar.

steps.text: Enter a populated @loc{Battle Hub} and approach an idle avatar.
Inspect the idle avatar and use the displayed @mechanic{Nice} action.
Continue sending Nices through idle avatars, online match results, or spectator screens until the combined counter reaches @mechanic{200}.

achievements.description: Having outside support is a bit like having a spirit. You can't see them, but they lend you strength all the same. Send or receive 600 "Nice!" marks, and you'll feel strong too.
achievements.summary: Reach a combined total of @mechanic{600 Nice marks sent or received} in Street Fighter 6 online modes.

guide.context: Sending and receiving Nices feed the same counter, so use every available prompt after online matches, while spectating, and when inspecting idle avatars.

steps.text: Join a populated @loc{Battle Hub} and approach an idle avatar.
Inspect the idle avatar and use the displayed @mechanic{Nice} action.
Continue sending Nices through idle avatars, online match results, or spectator screens until the combined sent-and-received counter reaches @mechanic{600}.

achievements.description: I used to ask millions of questions as an agent. There's a lot you can learn from people just by talking to them—try chatting in the Battle Hub.
achievements.summary: Type and send any message in the @mechanic{Battle Hub chat} window.

guide.context: This is a single-message interaction rather than a conversation requirement; no reply from another player is needed.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Battle Hub} and activate the chat window shown at the lower-right of the screen.
Enter any text and send the message to the hub chat.

achievements.description: Reviewing replay footage is a great way to learn from past fights. Watch with a calm, subjective eye, and you're bound to make some discoveries.
achievements.summary: Open @mechanic{Multi Menu > Capcom Fighting Network}, select any replay, and begin watching it.

guide.context: Any CFN replay qualifies; the replay does not need to feature the player's account or be watched to its conclusion.

steps.text: Open the @mechanic{Multi Menu} and select @mechanic{Capcom Fighting Network (CFN)}.
Choose any available replay and start playback.

achievements.description: Earned any titles for your efforts yet? Me? Pfft. I don't need a title. I'm Jamie freakin' Siu!
achievements.summary: Unlock any player @item{title} through World Tour, Battle Hub, Fighting Ground, or a promotional reward.

guide.context: Titles come from many activities and promotional rewards; earning one is sufficient. The title never has to be equipped.

steps.text: Complete an activity or claim a reward that grants any player @item{title}.
Allow the title reward to register; do not spend time changing the active title.

achievements.description: A lone wolf is strong, but they're far more fearsome if they have a pack to call their own. So go on—try making some friends!
achievements.summary: Open another player's profile and send a @mechanic{friend request}.

guide.context: The request itself is the trigger; the recipient does not need to accept it.

steps.text: While connected online, open any other player's profile.
Select @mechanic{Send Friend Request} and confirm the request.

achievements.description: Clothing allows us to express ourselves. Know who else never changes their clothes? Animals. Change your outfit. Please.
achievements.summary: Obtain or buy avatar clothing, then open @mechanic{Character > Status} and equip a different clothing item.

guide.context: The outfit change works in either World Tour or Battle Hub after any wearable item has been obtained or purchased.

steps.text: Obtain or buy at least one avatar clothing item.
Open the avatar @mechanic{Character} menu, select @mechanic{Status}, and change one equipped clothing slot.
Confirm the new outfit so the appearance change is saved.

achievements.description: Have you had a chance to jam out at the DJ Booth in the Battle Hub, bud? Pick your favorite tunes, and light the dance floor aflame!
achievements.summary: Reach the balcony @loc{DJ Booth} in Battle Hub, use the console, and start a music session.

guide.context: The DJ Booth is separate from the Game Center and central big-screen seating, so look above the main cabinet floor.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Battle Hub} and climb to the balcony containing the @loc{DJ Booth}.
Stand behind the DJ console, interact with its controls, and start playing music.

achievements.description: Sit down by the big monitor in the Battle Hub, and you can view all kinds of stuff. Man... Used to be me up there going wild on the big screen.
achievements.summary: Use one of the seats facing the large central monitor in @loc{Battle Hub}.

guide.context: The trigger is the seating interaction near the big screen; no particular broadcast or event needs to be playing.

steps.text: Locate the large central monitor in @loc{Battle Hub}.
Approach a seat facing the monitor and use the sit interaction.

achievements.description: You gotta help people in need. I mean, that's the secret to keeping any city peaceful. So get out there and complete 22 sub-missions, got it?
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{22 sub-missions} in @loc{World Tour}; use the blue map markers and check both day and night.

guide.context: World Tour contains more than 22 sub-missions, so difficult or inconvenient quests can be skipped. Some missions only appear during a particular time of day.

steps.text: Progress the World Tour main story until blue sub-mission markers begin appearing.
Accept and finish available sub-missions, changing between day and night when no suitable markers remain.
Continue until @mechanic{22 completed sub-missions} have registered.

achievements.description: Once you find someone to call a master, you would do well to seek to deepen your bonds. Raise the bond with one of your masters to 100.
achievements.summary: Become a World Tour master's disciple, then complete master missions and give presents until that master's @mechanic{Bond reaches 100}.

guide.context: Master missions increase Bond, but presents provide the fastest repeatable gains. Only one master needs to reach the maximum.

steps.text: Become the disciple of a preferred World Tour master.
Complete that master's available missions and acquire presents the master accepts.
Speak with the same master and keep giving presents until the displayed @mechanic{Bond reaches 100}.

achievements.description: Complete the World Tour main story.
achievements.summary: Finish all @mechanic{47 main missions across 15 chapters} of @loc{World Tour}.

guide.context: The final Tournament is a notable difficulty spike. Improving the avatar's level and equipment during the story is more reliable than rushing the last chapter underpowered.

steps.text: Follow the World Tour main missions through all @mechanic{15 chapters}, upgrading the avatar's level and gear along the way.
Complete the final Tournament and the remaining story objectives until the World Tour ending is reached.
Allow the ending and completion state to register on Steam.

achievements.description: Complete the World Tour tutorial.
achievements.summary: Complete the opening tutorial inside @loc{World Tour}.

guide.context: This hidden achievement is tied specifically to World Tour's basic training. Replaying the separate Fighting Ground tutorial does not satisfy it.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{World Tour} from the main menu and create or load your avatar.
Follow the opening objectives and finish the complete World Tour tutorial sequence.

achievements.description: I've worked a few odd jobs during my travels, and they all helped me with my training. You should take up a part-time job during your World Tour, as well.
achievements.summary: Complete any @mechanic{part-time job} in @loc{World Tour}, such as the Pizza minigame.

guide.context: Part-time jobs are optional World Tour activities. The early Pizza job or the job encountered around Chun-Li's Chinatown section provides a quick first completion.

steps.text: Progress through @loc{World Tour} until a part-time job becomes available.
Start the job, complete its stated minigame objective, and reach the results screen.

achievements.description: Something in the way while you're walking through the city? Here's an easy solution: send it flyin' with a Master Action! Mm-mm-mmm... It's the little pleasures in life.
achievements.summary: Become a World Tour master's disciple, learn that master's @mechanic{Master Action}, and use it to break a barrel or crate.

guide.context: Becoming a disciple grants that master's fighting style, special moves, and field Master Action. Only the field action against a destructible object is needed here.

steps.text: Become the disciple of any World Tour master to unlock that master's @mechanic{Master Action}.
Find a destructible @item{barrel or crate} while exploring World Tour.
Aim the Master Action at the object and use it to destroy the barrel or crate.

achievements.description: Fight 100 online battles via Fighting Ground. What's that? Too difficult, you say? If you wish to take on the world, there can be no other path.
achievements.summary: Finish @mechanic{100 online battles through Fighting Ground}; wins are not required.

guide.context: Only Fighting Ground online matches satisfy this counter. Battle Hub cabinet and Avatar Battles belong to separate totals.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Fighting Ground} and enter an online matchmaking mode.
Finish complete online matches, taking rematches when convenient, until the Fighting Ground total reaches @mechanic{100}.

achievements.description: Gonna need ya to head to the Fighting Ground and finish Arcade Mode once, buddy! It's time ya heard the stories of your fellow fighters!
achievements.summary: Finish one complete @mechanic{Arcade Mode} run with any character in @loc{Fighting Ground}.

guide.context: Only one character story is required, so this can be done with a preferred fighter and comfortable Arcade settings.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Fighting Ground > Arcade} and select any character.
Finish every fight in the selected Arcade run and reach its ending.

achievements.description: You've heard of combo trials, I presume? It's time you practice attack sequences. I want you to finish 45 of them. It will be difficult, but I've the utmost faith in you.
achievements.summary: Complete a cumulative @mechanic{45 Combo Trials} under @mechanic{Fighting Ground > Practice}.

guide.context: The total can be spread across the roster. Clearing two or three early trials for many base characters avoids relying on the hardest advanced sequences.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Fighting Ground > Practice > Combo Trials}.
Complete the easiest available trials for one or more characters.
Switch characters whenever the remaining trials become difficult and continue until @mechanic{45 trials} have registered.

achievements.description: You know how a swallow can fly at speeds of up to 200 kilometers an hour? Well, even they were chicks once. It's all about practice! Get yourself to Training Mode!
achievements.summary: Enter @mechanic{Training Mode} from the main-menu shortcut or @mechanic{Fighting Ground > Practice}.

guide.context: No drill, combo, or opponent defeat is required; loading the dedicated Training Mode is the trigger.

steps.text: Use the Training Mode shortcut on the main menu, or open @mechanic{Fighting Ground > Practice > Training}.
Choose a character and allow the training stage to finish loading.

achievements.description: Whoa, you seen these Character Guide things? Talk about rad! They've got all kinds of info about people's fighting styles and moves. Oh yeah, Bushinryu gets some rep too, naturally.
achievements.summary: Complete any one entry under @mechanic{Fighting Ground > Practice > Character Guides}.

guide.context: Character Guides are separate from Tutorials and Combo Trials, and no full-roster completion is required.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Fighting Ground > Practice > Character Guides}.
Select any character and finish one complete guide entry.

achievements.description: You want to learn street fighting fundamentals? Well, too bad, 'cause I'm not in the mood to take on any students. Go hit the Tutorials, kid.
achievements.summary: Complete a lesson from @mechanic{Fighting Ground > Practice > Tutorials}.

guide.context: The basic tutorial may start automatically on the first Fighting Ground visit; otherwise the same lessons remain available under the Practice tab.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Fighting Ground} and select @mechanic{Practice > Tutorials}.
Start a tutorial lesson and complete every prompted action until the lesson ends.
